files.app/api/og/lobby/[code]/route.tsx: Route handler returning an ImageResponse. It renders one cached PNG per lobby code for link-preview crawlers (Slack, Discord, iMessage), not for a signed-in viewer, so there is no locale to render in and useTranslation() cannot run outside a component.
files.app/opengraph-image.tsx: Next.js metadata image convention: a build-time ImageResponse, one static PNG for the whole site. No request, no viewer and no React component, so there is no locale to pick and no hook to call.
files.app/twitter-image.tsx: Next.js metadata image convention: a build-time ImageResponse, one static PNG for the whole site. No request, no viewer and no React component, so there is no locale to pick and no hook to call.
